description: This file defines a PassManager class and related functions for managing and executing passes with constraints in the torch.fx framework, including pass scheduling, validation, and execution control.

classes.name: PassManager
classes.description: Class for managing a collection of passes and constraints, validating, solving constraints, and executing passes on a torch.fx GraphModule.

methods.name: pass_result_wrapper
methods.description: Decorator that wraps a pass function to ensure it returns a PassResult, adding a 'modified' flag.

methods.name: _validate_pass_schedule_constraint
methods.description: Validates that a given pass schedule constraint is not violated within a list of passes.

methods.name: _topological_sort_passes
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of passes based on constraints, detecting circular dependencies.

methods.name: this_before_that_pass_constraint
methods.description: Creates a constraint function that enforces one pass to occur before another.
